mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in slowing economy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.5pp.
